Method of Attack: Infects Android devices via compromised Mobile Device Manager (MDM) server
Uses Android Accessibility Service abuse to gain permissions and bypass user interaction
Displays fake Accessibility Service update dialogs to trick users into enabling permissions
Steals sensitive information including call logs, text messages, credentials, Google Authenticator 2FA codes, phone unlocking patterns, installed apps info, and keystrokes
Uses TeamViewer-based remote access Trojan (RAT) capabilities for full remote control
Downloads ring0.apk module to harvest contacts, SMS, installed apps, send SMS, make calls, send USSD requests, show notifications, install/uninstall apps, and open popup activities with URLs
Blocks attempts to uninstall TeamViewer and itself by gaining admin privileges and closing App Detail pages
Disables Google Play Protect by abusing Accessibility Service to prevent detection and removal
Impacted Systems: Android devices managed by the compromised MDM server of a multinational conglomerate
Attack Vector: Compromised Mobile Device Manager (MDM) server used to remotely deploy malware
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control server IP addresses
